title: The Bible says all have sinned.
paragraphs:
The Bible says all have sinned.
Not some. Not most. All.

If sin is real… forgiveness isn’t optional.
It’s the only hope we have.
And that forgiveness has a name: Jesus Christ.

If sin is actually real…
then nobody walks away innocent.
That means every one of us needs forgiveness.

The real question is:
Where are you looking for it?
If sin exists… do you believe everyone needs forgiveness?
Or do you think people are basically good? 👀
